technology_name: ML-Based Rainfall Nowcasting: Short-Term Precipitation Forecasting System
technology_type: AI/ML Model or Algorithm, Software/Digital Platform
problem_solved: Lack of high-resolution, short-term rainfall predictions that account for complex spatial and temporal patterns across diverse local terrains.
description: An experimental machine learning-based forecasting tool that provides high-resolution, short-term rainfall predictions. The system utilizes real-time infrared and water vapor data from geostationary satellites alongside a high-resolution Digital Elevation Model (DEM) to account for local terrain influences like elevation and slope. The data is processed through a Convolutional Long Short-Term Memory (ConvLSTM) deep learning architecture designed to recognize complex spatiotemporal patterns. The model outputs dynamic rainfall intensity maps (mm/hr) that update continuously as new satellite data is received.
applications:
• Disaster preparedness and early warning systems by emergency management agencies

• Short-term agricultural planning and active crop protection

• Water resource management and municipal reservoir operations

• Integration into commercial weather forecasting and meteorological platforms
